disp.bbbTip: When on: orders are sent with only the first block (complete=false); the next block is appended via /addBlocks once the previous one is FINISHED, then /markComplete after the last. Appending never stops while the order is not terminal: order/block FAILED, Error, SUSPENDED or query errors only pause (warning) and keep polling, appending resumes on recovery. Stops only when the order is FINISHED/STOPPED (incl. cancel in this tool). Applies to subsequent sends
inc.waiting: order/block abnormal, paused until recovery (still polling)
